Name: Pet Out Of My Way
Author: G3sila
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Tired of your cute pets block your way and cannot make it to bed before 2:00? I got you. [/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This mod allows you to[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4] pass your pet in no time[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=3], save you from pushing for 2 seconds...[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]** We also make it [/size][/color][color=#f1c232][size=3]ajustable[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=3] in configuration, so if you would like some of the [/size][/color][color=#93c47d][size=3]vanilla taste[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=3] and NOT make your pet simply a ghost, you can just shorten the time! [/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]** Compatible with Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI needed[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]* adjust pet-been-pushed-time & time-able-to-pass[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]* flexible configuration[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]* translation enabled[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Pet Out Of My Way
Manifest.Description: No more pet stuck in your way back to bed! Pass through it without wait.
Manifest.Author: Gesila
